The goal? Become the most feared, worshipped, or envied ruler of Catvale - how you get there is entirely up to you. | The game unfolds on a dynamic, tile-based map that creates a unique, ever-changing environment, ensuring no two games are ever the same. A fresh take on the adventure genre, Catvale blends exploration, resource management, and tactical decision-making. Players can choose from different playstyles—eco-focused, brawler, builder, adventurer, or a hybrid approach. Action dice, rolled at the start of each round, determine the strength of the actions players can take, adding an element of strategy and unpredictability.
